caption: The drawing depicts two spherical objects, both dark brown in color with visible highlights and subtle variations in shading to suggest a metallic surface. Each sphere is supported by three short, curved legs resembling clawed feet. The object on the left features a circular dial with the words "THE GLOBE" prominently inscribed in capital letters, along with a smaller ring of numbers or letters, and a single knob in the center. The right sphere is plain, without any inscriptions or dials, but has a faintly visible groove or seam running along its upper half. The objects are set against a plain, light beige background with a simple, thin border framing the entire composition. The artist's signature, "W.O. Fletcher," appears in the lower right corner.
title: The Globe Coin Bank
